name: 03-방선택-안방
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const f = v.floors.find(f => f.userData.room.name === '안방'); const r = f.userData.room; const c = r.cells[Math.floor(r.cells.length / 2)]; const M = window.APT_MODEL; const p = new v.THREE.Vector3((c[0]+c[2])/2 - M.extent[0]/2, 0.002, (c[1]+c[3])/2 - M.extent[1]/2).project(v.camera); const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas'); const b = cv.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = b.left + (p.x+1)/2*b.width, y = b.top + (1-p.y)/2*b.height; for (const t of ['pointerdown','pointerup']) cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(t, { button: 0, clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true })); return document.getElementById('info').innerText })()

name: 04-빈곳클릭-선택해제
js: (() => { const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas'); const b = cv.getBoundingClientRect(); for (const t of ['pointerdown','pointerup']) cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(t, { button: 0, clientX: b.left + 15, clientY: b.top + 15, bubbles: true })); return document.getElementById('info').innerText })()

name: 05-치수재기-거실가로
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const M = window.APT_MODEL; const r = M.rooms.find(r => r.name === '거실'); const c = r.cells[Math.floor(r.cells.length / 2)]; const yMid = (c[1]+c[3])/2; const a = [c[0]+0.05, yMid], bb = [c[2]-0.05, yMid]; document.getElementById('measure-toggle').click(); const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas'); const b = cv.getBoundingClientRect(); const clickAt = ([mx, my]) => { const p = new v.THREE.Vector3(mx - M.extent[0]/2, 0.002, my - M.extent[1]/2).project(v.camera); const x = b.left + (p.x+1)/2*b.width, y = b.top + (1-p.y)/2*b.height; for (const t of ['pointerdown','pointerup']) cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(t, { button: 0, clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true })) }; clickAt(a); clickAt(bb); return { 기대값: (bb[0]-a[0]).toFixed(2), 화면표시: document.getElementById('measures').innerText } })()

name: 06-첫점후Esc취소
js: (() => { const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas'); const b = cv.getBoundingClientRect(); for (const t of ['pointerdown','pointerup']) cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(t, { button: 0, clientX: b.left + b.width/2, clientY: b.top + b.height/2, bubbles: true })); window.__before = __viewer.scene.children.find(c => c.type === 'Group' && c.children.some(x => x.element?.className === 'measure-label')).children.length; window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape' })); const after = __viewer.scene.children.find(c => c.type === 'Group' && c.children.some(x => x.element?.className === 'measure-label')).children.length; return { 첫점찍은후: window.__before, Esc후: after } })()

name: 10-가까이확대
js: (() => { document.getElementById('show-grid').click(); document.getElementById('show-labels').click(); document.getElementById('wall-full').click(); const v = __viewer; v.controls.target.set(-0.4, 1.0, 2.6); v.camera.position.set(-0.4, 1.3, 1.6); v.controls.update(); return v.camera.position.distanceTo(v.controls.target).toFixed(2) + 'm 거리' })()
